text:
maya_docs: PR #4476 ready for review — migration examples + SDK snippets for the new client init. Netlify preview shows but the example link to /examples/python/404s intermittently. Need a reviewer and a merge slot tomorrow morning (07:15 UTC). preview: https://deploy-preview-4476--redwood-docs.netlify.app :wave:

ci-bot: Netlify build completed with warnings. One 404 on /examples/python/index.html during preview run. Full log: https://netlify-logs.example/4476

frank_infra: can you paste the mkdocs.yml base settings and any manual includes that reference /examples/python/?

maya_docs: mkdocs.yml has use_directory_urls: true and site_url: "https://docs.redwood.ai". The snippet include uses `/examples/python/` absolute paths in a toc include. I tested locally and it served fine.

jen_sre: previews sometimes race when assets or generated directories are uploaded separately. Local repro steps for folks: `git fetch origin pull/4476/head:pr-4476 && git checkout pr-4476 && pip install -r requirements.txt && mkdocs build --clean && python -m http.server --directory site 8002` then open http://localhost:8002/examples/python/

frank_infra: quick check: Netlify will sometimes rewrite paths if base is absolute. Try switching the include to relative paths `examples/python/` (no leading slash) and push a tiny fix to re-trigger. Also confirm `site/examples/python/index.html` exists after build.

maya_docs: making that change now and adding a note in the PR about the absolute vs relative path issue. Pushed and retriggered Netlify.

netlify-bot: Deploy started for branch docs/pr-4476-preview (preview-4476).

ci-bot: Deploy failed (404 persists) — logs show two references to unhashed asset `examples/python/tutorial.js` and one hashed `examples/python/tutorial-7c3a.js`. Suggest grepping the built site for `tutorial.js` to find stale includes.

frank_infra: I can take a look. ETA ~20m. If we can't get preview green, is merging into staging without a preview acceptable?

maya_docs: prefer to keep preview green — PMs use the preview for QA. If needed we can ask for a special merge slot at 07:15 and SRE can watch staging deploy.

frank_infra: found a legacy include in docs/includes/code_examples.html that references `tutorial.js` directly. Pushing a fix to use the assets manifest variable instead of the hardcoded name.

netlify-bot: Redeploy started for preview-4476.

ci-bot: Deploy succeeded — preview available at https://deploy-preview-4476--redwood-docs.netlify.app/examples/python/ :white_check_mark:

maya_docs: fantastic, thank you. Can one of you approve so I can merge into the 07:15 UTC slot? Tagging @frank_infra and @jen_sre.

frank_infra: reviewed and approved from infra side. minor nit about a code comment but not blocking.

jen_sre: reviewed from SRE side — please include the local repro steps in the PR description for future triage. Approved.

maya_docs: will merge at 07:15 UTC. Leaving the thread open for any last minute blockers. :hourglass:
